implementation_summary: Defined dependency-free domain entities, validation-oriented value objects, typed commands and queries, repository and transaction ports, outbound fetch and credential boundaries, ingestion/ranking ports, service interfaces, stable error categories, and focused contract tests.

files_changed.change: Added profile, source, article, library, ranking, refresh, identifier, validation, and package-contract types.
Added commands, queries, errors, repositories, transaction, clock, fetcher, credential, ingestion, ranking, and use-case service ports plus compile-time tests.
Recorded task claim, submission, and review state without marking the task done.

verification.output: Both packages passed focused validation and compile-time interface tests.
Full Go vet/test, frontend lint/typecheck/test/build, PWA build, and Go build passed.

verification.command: go list import-boundary check for internal/domain and internal/application
verification.output: Domain imports only errors, math, net/url, strings, and time; application imports only context, errors, io, time, and internal/domain. No database, HTTP framework, adapters, SQLite, or Windows implementation import is present.
Post-review revision passed race-enabled focused tests, vet, and the complete repository verification suite.

proof.summary: Focused domain/application tests and full repository verification passed.
Import inspection confirms dependency inversion and absence of concrete infrastructure dependencies.
Persistent port inventory and dependency boundary for downstream implementers.

notes: Reviewer revision 1 rejected mandatory location and free-form adapter configuration.
